title: Kubernetes scheduling evidence
summary: Read FailedScheduling events and placement constraints without jumping directly to disruptive changes.

concepts.title: Resource fit
concepts.explanation: Scheduler events can report insufficient allocatable CPU or memory for requested resources.

concepts.title: Placement constraints
concepts.explanation: Taints, selectors, affinity, topology and host ports can make otherwise healthy nodes ineligible.

concepts.title: Dependencies
concepts.explanation: Storage claims, quota and custom scheduler behavior can block placement.

limitations: An event describes scheduler evidence at a point in time, not a universal root cause.
Reducing requests or removing constraints can alter reliability and policy.
